how_to_edit: Every item the party can pick up in a dungeon (chests, treasure pedestals, the starter relic, merchants) lives in this file.
Items are grouped by who can use them: any_class, melee_only, ranged_only. Move an item between groups to change who can find it.
class_groups says which classes count as melee and ranged.
name: shown to players. rarity: uncommon, rare, very_rare or legendary (there's no common tier; drop rates by rarity are in loot_tables.json).
lasts: every item lasts the whole run (lost when the expedition ends).

stats: flat bonuses such as dex (Dexterity: each point is faster movement, see slasher_balance.json simple_combat.move_speed_*), max_health (hearts), attack_speed, gold_bonus_percent, xp_bonus_percent, potion_heal_bonus, defense, armor_class.

combat.room_ward: true blocks the first hit taken in each room. Proc types drop_potion (a healing potion) and drop_gold (amount_min..amount_max coins) put loot on the floor; use them with on: kill or on: hit and a chance.
To add an item, copy an existing block, give it a new unique id (lowercase_with_underscores) and change its fields.

combat (optional): how the item behaves in real-time combat. 'rules' is the text players read; 'trigger' is passive, hit, potion_use, floor_entry, action_complete, lethal_damage and so on; other numbers tune the effect.
stats also take attack_speed (percent faster basic attacks, e.g. 15 = 15% faster, capped at 100) and move_speed (percent faster movement).
combat.procs (optional): a list of special effects. Each has a type and 'on' (when it happens: swing = basic attack, special, dash, hit = you strike an enemy, kill = you kill one).
Proc options for every type: chance (0-1, default 1), every (only every Nth time, e.g. 3 = every third swing), cooldown (seconds between triggers), message (optional popup text).

type wave: a crescent that flies forward through enemies. element (fire, wind, lightning, ice, poison, arcane), damage_percent (of the attack that caused it), damage (flat), range, speed, width, count + spread_degrees (fan of several), color (hex), burn / chill (same options as below, applied to everything it hits).
type chain_lightning: leaps from the target to nearby enemies. damage_percent, damage, jumps, jump_range.
type burn: sets the target alight. damage (per half-second tick), damage_percent, duration.  type chill: slows the target. slow (0.5 = half speed), duration.
type nova: a burst around the target (or you, for swing/special/dash). damage_percent, damage, radius, element, knockback.  type heal: amount.
See docs/ItemEffects.md for worked examples.
drops: false keeps an item out of chests and shops without deleting it. note: a reminder for the team, not shown in game.
turn_based (optional): rules for the older turn-based combat mode. Leave it alone unless you are working on that mode.
Run tests/pickup_items_test.gd after editing to check the file.

charred_horseshoe.name: Charred Horseshoe
charred_horseshoe.description: A smoke-black iron shoe that still remembers the open road.

turn_based.rules_text: After crossing a Field-room doorway, gain +1 Evasion until your next turn.

combat.rules: +1 Dexterity: you move faster.

healers_brooch.name: Healer's Brooch
healers_brooch.description: Silver leaves unfold when restorative draughts touch the tongue.

combat.rules: Enemies you kill have a 5% chance to drop a healing potion.

turn_based.rules_text: Drinking a potion also clears Slow and restores 1 class resource.

ironroot_ring.name: Ironroot Ring
ironroot_ring.description: Iron-bound rootwood anchors flesh against forced movement.

turn_based.rules_text: Reduce forced movement by 1 tile and gain +1 physical Aegis.

combat.rules: +1 heart.

quickstep_charm.name: Quickstep Charm
quickstep_charm.description: Seven wind-knots tighten after a committed dash.

combat.rules: +1 Dexterity: quicker on your feet.

turn_based.rules_text: After using a movement ability, gain +2 Evasion until your next turn.

scavengers_token.name: Scavenger's Token
scavengers_token.description: The token remembers overlooked corners after a room falls silent.

turn_based.rules_text: Clearing a floor grants 3 additional gold for each unopened chest or cache.

amulet_of_vigor.name: Amulet of Vigor
amulet_of_vigor.description: Green glass beats like a spare heart when yours falters.

turn_based.rules_text: Below half health, gain another +2 Threshold.

combat.rules: +1 heart of vigour.

apothecarys_cup.name: Apothecary's Cup
apothecarys_cup.description: Impossible measuring marks make every draught exact rather than merely strong.

turn_based.rules_text: Potions cannot overheal; unused healing becomes temporary Aegis, up to 3.

brambleguard_clasp.name: Brambleguard Clasp
brambleguard_clasp.description: Bronze thorns punish anything that presses into the wearer's guard.

turn_based.rules_text: When a melee defensive reaction triggers, deal 1 physical damage to the attacker.

deft_hands.name: Deft Hands
deft_hands.description: Soft, close-fitting gloves that never catch on a grip.

combat.rules: Your weapon recovers 10% faster: quicker attacks.

cutpurses_favor.name: Cutpurse's Favor
cutpurses_favor.description: The charm pays its bearer for precise, bloodless work.

turn_based.rules_text: Defeating an enemy while at full health grants 2 additional gold.

combat.rules: Each hit has a 1% chance to knock coins loose from the enemy.

lucky_coin.name: Lucky Coin
lucky_coin.description: The coin steals a little probability whenever an attack narrowly misses.

turn_based.rules_text: Once per turn, an attack that misses by 2 or less gains +2 Accuracy.

wayfinders_compass.name: Wayfinder's Compass
wayfinders_compass.description: Its needle points toward the safest useful square.

turn_based.rules_text: Movement abilities gain +1 Range; landing unengaged restores 1 class resource.

windrunner_boots.name: Windrunner Boots
windrunner_boots.description: Soft-soled boots that never quite touch the ground.

combat.rules: +1 Dexterity: the wind at your heels.

blackoak_ward.name: Blackoak Ward
blackoak_ward.description: Blackoak is too dense to yield to weak blows.

turn_based.rules_text: Physical damage stopped by Threshold restores 1 class resource.

combat.rules: Blocks the first hit you take in each room.

boots_of_the_hare.name: Boots of the Hare
boots_of_the_hare.description: A stored spring releases whenever danger closes from several sides.

turn_based.rules_text: While adjacent to two or more enemies, gain +2 Evasion.

combat.rules: +2 Dexterity: you move faster.

gilded_beetle.name: Gilded Beetle
gilded_beetle.description: The jeweled beetle wakes whenever fortune produces an excess.

turn_based.rules_text: Gold pickups of 10 or more restore 1 class resource.

quicksilver_locket.name: Quicksilver Locket
quicksilver_locket.description: A bead of living metal races round the locket faster than the eye can follow.

combat.rules: Basic attacks are 12% faster, and +1 Dexterity: you move faster.

saints_phial.name: Saint's Phial
saints_phial.description: The empty phial preserves the echo of healing for the next wound.

turn_based.rules_text: After drinking a potion, gain 2 Aegis against the next damage type received.

rimefrost_chain.name: Rimefrost Chain
rimefrost_chain.description: Every link is furred with frost that never melts.

combat.rules: Hits have a 35% chance to chill the enemy, slowing them for 1.6 seconds.

war_scholars_codex.name: War Scholar's Codex
war_scholars_codex.description: Margins compare monster anatomy with diagrams of battle magic.

turn_based.rules_text: After first hitting an enemy, gain +1 Attack Power and Spell Potency against that enemy.

cinder_brand.name: Cinder Brand
cinder_brand.description: A branding iron's head, still glowing, lashed to the wrist.

combat.rules: Hits have a 25% chance to set the enemy alight, burning for a few seconds.

deepdelvers_lantern.name: Deepdelver's Lantern
deepdelvers_lantern.description: Pale flame reveals danger and treasure in equal measure.

turn_based.rules_text: Against undiscovered enemy types, gain +2 Accuracy and +2 Armor Class.

bursting_spore_sac.name: Bursting Spore Sac
bursting_spore_sac.description: Squeezed from a forest shroomie. It is still twitching.

combat.rules: Enemies you kill burst in a cloud of spores that hurts everything nearby.

kingsroad_aegis.name: Kingsroad Aegis
kingsroad_aegis.description: A royal ward turns the first wound of every battle into a glancing blow.

turn_based.rules_text: The first damaging hit each combat gains 3 Aegis against its damage type.

sunward_periapt.name: Sunward Periapt
sunward_periapt.description: Sunlight pools in the periapt and refuses to let healing go to waste.

turn_based.rules_text: Healing at full health grants 2 temporary Aegis against all damage.

combat.rules: +2 hearts, and +2 Dexterity: you move faster.

thunderheart_amulet.name: Thunderheart Amulet
thunderheart_amulet.description: A storm sealed in amber. It beats when something dies nearby.

combat.rules: Killing an enemy has a 50% chance to release chain lightning that leaps between up to 4 enemies.

aegis_of_the_last_king.name: Aegis of the Last King
aegis_of_the_last_king.description: A broken royal seal remembers a kingdom that refused every kind of ruin.

combat.rules: Survive one lethal hit per floor.

turn_based.rules_text: A triggered reaction doubles Aegis against that attack and heals 2 afterward.

fortune_eaters_idol.name: Fortune-Eater's Idol
fortune_eaters_idol.description: The idol consumes lucky outcomes and returns them as escalating rewards.

turn_based.rules_text: Natural 20s grant 3 gold; natural 1s consume 3 gold to reroll when possible.

heartwood_crown.name: Heartwood Crown
heartwood_crown.description: Living roots harden when their bearer refuses to move.

combat.rules: +1 heart, and recover 1 heart on each floor entry.

turn_based.rules_text: If you have not moved this turn, gain +3 Armor Class and +2 Threshold.

drillmasters_whistle.name: Drillmaster's Whistle
drillmasters_whistle.description: One sharp note turns a successful defense into a practiced lesson.
drillmasters_whistle.note: Only grants XP, which does nothing while levelling is switched off.

turn_based.rules_text: A triggered defensive reaction grants 2 bonus XP and 1 class resource.

keen_edge_oil.name: Keen Edge Oil
keen_edge_oil.description: Its first clean cut parts armor before the oil burns away.

combat.rules: Slasher: gain attack power for its remaining floors.

turn_based.rules_text: Your first attack each combat gains +2 Penetration and +1 Attack Power.

sparkwire_wrap.name: Sparkwire Wrap
sparkwire_wrap.description: Copper wire discharges into the first target struck each round.

turn_based.rules_text: Your first hit each round deals 2 additional lightning damage.

duelist_gloves.name: Duelist Gloves
duelist_gloves.description: The gloves guide a blade toward whichever opening appears first.

turn_based.rules_text: Against an isolated enemy, gain +2 Accuracy and +1 Penetration.

veterans_whetstone.name: Veteran's Whetstone
veterans_whetstone.description: A scarred whetstone favors repeated blows against the same foe.

turn_based.rules_text: Consecutive attacks against the same target gain +1 Accuracy and +1 Penetration.

giant_bane_grip.name: Giant-Bane Grip
giant_bane_grip.description: The grip tightens around weapons raised against oversized or elite prey.

combat.rules: Slasher: deal 16% more damage to elites and bosses.

turn_based.rules_text: Against elite and boss enemies, gain +3 Penetration.

runebound_bracer.name: Runebound Bracer
runebound_bracer.description: A warm rune divides its loyalty between blade and guard.

turn_based.rules_text: After a defensive reaction triggers, your next martial attack gains +2 Accuracy.

titanblood_torc.name: Titanblood Torc
titanblood_torc.description: A bronze second pulse turns pain into crushing force.

turn_based.rules_text: Below half health, gain +3 Attack Power but lose 1 Evasion.

wyvernscale_mantle.name: Wyvernscale Mantle
wyvernscale_mantle.description: Overlapping scales turn poison and blades in different ways.

turn_based.rules_text: When poison damage is fully absorbed, gain +2 Attack Power next turn.

worldbreaker_gauntlet.name: Worldbreaker Gauntlet
worldbreaker_gauntlet.description: Its runes turn excess force into fractures that outlast the blow.

combat.rules: Slasher: impacts gain power, knockback, and area.

turn_based.rules_text: Martial hits reduce the target's Threshold by 1 for the rest of combat.

emberwind_edge.name: Emberwind Edge
emberwind_edge.description: A whetted ember-steel band that clips onto any blade. Swing hard enough and the air catches fire.

combat.rules: Every third swing hurls a crescent of fire that cuts through enemies and leaves them burning.

galecutter_charm.name: Galecutter Charm
galecutter_charm.description: A carved feather that hums when it moves fast.

combat.rules: Swings have a 30% chance to loose a cutting gust of wind that passes through enemies.

stormcall_pommel.name: Stormcall Pommel
stormcall_pommel.description: A copper pommel that crackles when it strikes bone.

combat.rules: Hits have a 20% chance to call chain lightning that leaps between up to 3 enemies.

duelists_whetstone.name: Duelist's Whetstone
duelists_whetstone.description: A few passes and the blade feels half its weight.

combat.rules: Basic attacks are 15% faster.

tempest_brand.name: Tempest Brand
tempest_brand.description: The storm-god's mark, burned into a sword-hilt. Thunder follows the blade.

combat.rules: Basic attacks are 10% faster. Every fourth swing fires a fan of three lightning crescents.

chalk_rune_tablet.name: Chalk Rune Tablet
chalk_rune_tablet.description: The rune can be broken to force a spell through resistant wards.

turn_based.rules_text: Your first spell each floor gains +3 Penetration.

embershard_focus.name: Embershard Focus
embershard_focus.description: A disposable ember lens stretches fire beyond its natural reach.

combat.rules: Slasher: gain spell power for its remaining floors.

turn_based.rules_text: Fire attacks gain +1 Range and +1 Spell Potency.

scholars_lens.name: Scholar's Lens
scholars_lens.description: Every enemy defense becomes a lesson written in reflected light.
scholars_lens.note: Only grants XP, which does nothing while levelling is switched off.

turn_based.rules_text: After an attack is stopped by Threshold or Aegis, gain +1 Penetration for the next attack.

stormglass_bead.name: Stormglass Bead
stormglass_bead.description: A captive storm leaps farther after movement.

turn_based.rules_text: After moving, lightning attacks gain +1 Range and +2 Spell Potency.

wand_of_cinders.name: Wand of Cinders
wand_of_cinders.description: The wand banks heat until magic finds clustered prey.

combat.rules: Slasher: spell hits build precision; the cadence hit deals 25% bonus damage.

turn_based.rules_text: Spell attacks that can hit multiple tiles gain +1 Range.

aether_prism.name: Aether Prism
aether_prism.description: Each facet converts one school of harm into another angle of force.

turn_based.rules_text: Arcane attacks gain +1 Range and ignore 1 additional Aegis.

glass_magus_eye.name: Glass Magus Eye
glass_magus_eye.description: The lens exposes the thinnest seam in magical resistance.

turn_based.rules_text: Spell attacks gain Penetration equal to half their Range bonus.

chronomancers_pin.name: Chronomancer's Pin
chronomancers_pin.description: Its hands twitch backward at the instant an action goes wrong.

combat.rules: Slasher: periodically shave 0.4 seconds from active cooldowns.

turn_based.rules_text: Once per combat, reroll a missed attack and keep the new result.

flameheart_talisman.name: Flameheart Talisman
flameheart_talisman.description: The talisman rewards spellcasters who stand close enough to feel the heat.

combat.rules: Slasher: spell impacts gain an 18-pixel area burst.

turn_based.rules_text: Fire attacks made within 2 tiles gain +2 Spell Potency and +1 Penetration.

phoenix_ash_reliquary.name: Phoenix-Ash Reliquary
phoenix_ash_reliquary.description: Uncooling ash kindles when healing would otherwise be too late.

combat.rules: Slasher: survive one lethal hit per floor at 1 health.

turn_based.rules_text: Once per floor, lethal damage leaves you at 1 health and ignites adjacent enemies.

crown_of_the_first_flame.name: Crown of the First Flame
crown_of_the_first_flame.description: The first flame refuses resistance and feeds on fallen magic.

combat.rules: Slasher: specials gain 30% damage and a wider impact.

turn_based.rules_text: Fire attacks convert half of prevented damage into bonus damage on the next spell.

conductors_rod.name: Conductor's Rod
conductors_rod.description: A wand of twisted copper that drinks in stray sparks.

combat.rules: Spell hits have a 25% chance to arc chain lightning to up to 3 more enemies.

quickcast_band.name: Quickcast Band
quickcast_band.description: A ring etched with shortcuts through every incantation.

combat.rules: Basic casts are 15% faster.

pyre_lantern.name: Pyre Lantern
pyre_lantern.description: The flame inside it grows a little brighter with each soul it takes.

combat.rules: Enemies you kill erupt in a burst of flame.

zephyr_quill.name: Zephyr Quill
zephyr_quill.description: Words written with it lift off the page.

combat.rules: Basic casts have a 25% chance to also loose a crescent of wind.
